overall: The AG found no deliberation via Facebook but found several members violated the Law by failing to timely sign OML certification forms; because the committee had disbanded, no further remedial action was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the search committee deliberated outside a meeting when a member posted comments about committee business in a large, closed town Facebook group.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that these posts did not constitute deliberation and did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that committee members had not completed the required Open Meeting Law certification forms.
allegations.key_passage: However, since several members failed to timely sign the required certification form in their capacity as a member the Committee, we find a violation of the Open Meeting Law.
